## SECTION W1 — WEBSITE LEADS
**Source:** "W1 - Website lead intake" (old id Ota9hfoDSNc0gKla). **Starts from:** POST /webhook/website-lead (Header Auth)

Website form -> clinic lookup (Agency Registry) -> find / create / update the LEADS row -> Run_Log.
Staff alert is still a STUB (sends nothing, does not call W12).

## W1 - Website lead intake
Form (Vercel /api/lead route) -> POST /webhook/website-lead -> Grist **Leads** + **Run_Log**.

**After importing, set up once:**
1. Credentials (Credentials > Create, type *Header Auth*):
   - **Lead webhook secret**: Name `X-Lead-Secret`, Value = a long random string (same value goes in Vercel as N8N_LEAD_SECRET).
   - **Grist API**: Name `Authorization`, Value = `Bearer <your Grist API key>`.
   Then open the *Webhook* node and every blue *Grist* (HTTP Request) node and pick them.
2. Edit the **Config** node: registry_doc_id = the doc id of your *Agency Registry* Grist doc.
3. Test with the *Test URL*, then **Activate** the workflow (the Production URL only works when active).

The staff alert is a STUB: it builds the message but sends nothing yet.

## SECTION W3 — SPEED TO LEAD
**Source:** "W3 - Speed-to-lead" (old id WMrHLwPI0HIHCHTy). **Starts from:** Schedule: every 10 minutes

New leads waiting 30 min - 48 h -> guard (TEST_MODE / quiet hours) -> **W3 – Call 'W12 - WhatsApp send'** -> if sent: Escalated + Run_Log.

## W3 - Speed-to-lead
Every 10 minutes, for every ACTIVE clinic that is OPEN right now: finds leads still on Status = New that have waited 30+ minutes
and are not Escalated, runs the send guard, and (once WhatsApp is connected) alerts the clinic OWNER and ticks Escalated.

**Today the send is a STUB.** "Send escalation (stub)" builds the message and sends nothing, and Escalated is not set,
so nothing is lost when WhatsApp goes live. Open an execution and look at that node's output to see what would be sent.

**Clinic hours** come from the clinic's Settings rows open_time (e.g. 09:00), close_time (e.g. 19:00) and working_days (e.g. Mon-Sat).
Missing or unreadable = 08:00-21:00 every day. **Recipient** = Settings owner_phone; with TEST_MODE on (or the row missing) it goes to TEST_PHONE.

**Limits (Config node):** waits 30 min; ignores leads older than 48 h (old backlog); at most 10 alerts per clinic per run, oldest first.

**Set up once:** pick the *Grist API* credential in every Grist (HTTP Request) node, set registry_doc_id in Config
(grist_base_url has no trailing slash), then Activate. Set Settings > Error workflow > W11.
**When WhatsApp is ready:** replace "Send escalation (stub)" with the real send (output sent: true on success).

## SECTION W4 — BOOKING
**Source:** "W4 - Booking sync" (old id gekhZgOUG3Ja2610). **Starts from:** POST /webhook/cal?clinic=<slug> (Cal.com, HMAC-signed)

Verify the Cal.com signature -> clinic lookup -> create / reschedule / cancel the Appointments row (+ LEADS) -> Run_Log.
Booking confirmation is still a STUB (does not call W12). "W4 – Webhook" (path cal-w4-test) is the old unconnected test webhook, kept as exported.

## W4 - Booking sync (Cal.com -> Grist)
Cal.com booking created / rescheduled / cancelled -> Appointments row (+ Lead) -> Run_Log.
Webhook URL for Cal.com:  https://<your-tailscale-name>/webhook/cal?clinic=<Clinic_Slug>
(use the Test URL, .../webhook-test/cal?clinic=..., while testing; the workflow must be Active for the Production URL)

**Set up once**
1. Cal.com > Settings > Developer > Webhooks: Subscriber URL as above; triggers *Booking created / rescheduled / cancelled*;
   Secret = a long random string. Put the SAME string in the Config node below (cal_webhook_secret).
   While testing without a secret you may set require_signature to false - set it back to true afterwards.
2. Config node: registry_doc_id (and the secret). Keep the real secret out of any exported copy you commit to git.
3. Pick the *Grist API* credential in every Grist (HTTP Request) node.
4. Each Cal.com event type needs a REQUIRED phone question (Advanced > Booking questions): without a phone the run fails on purpose.
5. Settings > Error workflow > W11.

**Rules:** signature checked first. Duplicate BOOKING_CREATED (Cal.com retries) is skipped. A booking from someone with no lead yet creates one
(Source = Website, Status = Booked). The confirmation message is a STUB: nothing is sent; the send guard (opt-out, quiet hours, TEST_MODE) still runs
and any skip is shown in the Run_Log Error column.

## SECTION W5 — REMINDERS
**Source:** "W5 - Appointment reminders" (old id qK8PJnJXJq8nfvYh). **Starts from:** Schedule: every 15 minutes

Booked appointments due for the 24 h / 2 h reminder -> guard -> **W5 – Call 'W12 - WhatsApp send'** -> if sent: R24_Sent / R2_Sent + Run_Log.

## W5 - Appointment reminders (24h and 2h)
Every 15 minutes, for every ACTIVE clinic in the Agency Registry: finds Booked appointments that are due a reminder,
runs the send guard, and (once WhatsApp is connected) sends and ticks R24_Sent / R2_Sent.

**Today the send is a STUB.** "Send reminder (stub)" builds the message and sends nothing, and no sent flag is set,
so nothing is lost when WhatsApp goes live. Open an execution and look at that node's output to see what would be sent.

**Send guard** (n8n/snippets/send-guard.js): skips if already sent, patient opted out, quiet hours 21:00-08:00 IST.
**TEST_MODE** (clinic Settings row): sends go to TEST_PHONE instead of the patient. A missing TEST_MODE row counts as ON.

**Windows** (Config node): 24h reminder when the appointment is 20-24 hours away; 2h reminder when it is 45-120 minutes away.

**Set up once:** pick the *Grist API* credential in every Grist (HTTP Request) node, set registry_doc_id in Config
(grist_base_url has no trailing slash),
then Activate. Needs the W11 error workflow set under Settings > Error workflow.
**When WhatsApp is ready:** replace "Send reminder (stub)" with the real send (output sent: true on success).

## SECTION W6 — FOLLOW UPS
**Source:** "W6 - Follow-ups" (old id CKLSYcYcauxPWKvg). **Starts from:** Schedule: cron 0 10 * * * (n8n timezone, Asia/Kolkata in docker-compose)

No-show rebook, day-2 follow-up, mark Lost (mark_lost is OFF in Config) -> guard -> **W6 – Call 'W12 - WhatsApp send'** -> if sent: Rebook_Sent / Followup_Sent + Run_Log.

## W6 - Follow-ups (daily 10:00 India time)
For every ACTIVE clinic in the Agency Registry:
1. **No-show rebook** - appointments marked No-show yesterday or the day before, Rebook_Sent empty, patient has no new booking -> "we missed you" message (one per patient).
2. **Day-2 follow-up** - leads still New / Contacted, created 2-6 days ago, Followup_Sent off, nothing booked -> one "would you like to book?" message.
3. **Mark Lost** - leads still New / Contacted 7+ days after they came in, nothing booked, no future Next_Action_At -> Status = Lost, Lost_Reason = No response.
   This one is a REAL change today (it is not a message). Set mark_lost to false in Config to switch it off.

**Messages are a STUB today.** "Send message (stub)" builds them and sends nothing; no flag is set, so nothing is lost when WhatsApp goes live.
The send guard runs first: skips opted-out patients, conversations with Automation_Paused (follow-ups count as marketing), quiet hours;
TEST_MODE (or the row missing) sends to TEST_PHONE. The booking link comes from Settings > booking_link.

**Config:** lookback 2 days for no-shows, follow-up after 2 days, Lost after 7 days, max 30 follow-ups and 50 Lost per clinic per run.
**Set up once:** pick the *Grist API* credential in every Grist (HTTP Request) node, set registry_doc_id, Settings > Error workflow > W11, Activate.
**When WhatsApp is ready:** replace "Send message (stub)" with the real send (output sent: true on success).

## SECTION W11 — ERROR HANDLER
**Source:** "W11 - Error alert" (old id bzsRGJqIW1xcM9eQ). **Starts from:** Error Trigger: any failed production run of THIS workflow

Runs only when another run of this workflow FAILS (production runs, not editor test runs). Telegram alert with workflow, step (node name = module), trimmed error. Same failure at most once per 10 min.
No loop: n8n never starts the error run again when the error run itself fails.

## W11 - Error alert (Telegram)
Any workflow that fails -> this one -> a Telegram message in your "agency-alerts" group.
The message holds only the workflow name, step, a trimmed error text and a link. No patient data.
The same failure alerts at most once per 10 minutes (so a Grist outage doesn't flood your phone).

**Set up once:**
1. Telegram: make a bot with @BotFather, make a group "agency-alerts", add the bot to it.
2. n8n > Credentials > Create > **Telegram API**, paste the bot token, save as "Telegram agency-alerts bot". Pick it in the *Telegram alert* node.
3. Edit the **Config** node: telegram_chat_id = the group's chat id (a negative number like -100123...).
4. Open each workflow you want covered (start with W1) > ... menu > **Settings** > *Error workflow* > choose this workflow > Save.

Does not need to be activated.

## SECTION W12 — WHATSAPP SEND ENGINE
**Source:** "W12 - WhatsApp send" (old id wJyVEscB9qqKOOx3). **Starts from:** Execute Workflow Trigger (called by W3 / W5 / W6, one item per call) + Manual test

The ONE place that talks to Meta. Entered at "W12 – When called by another workflow" through an Execute Workflow node that calls THIS workflow, one item per call, so every caller gets its own result back.
Safety kept: decision from the caller, send_mode allowlist, quiet hours, template check, Meta call, classification, Grist inbox log.

## W12 - WhatsApp send (reusable sub-workflow)
Other workflows call this with **Execute Workflow** (mode: *Run once for each item*, *Wait for completion* on).
It sends ONE approved template message through the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API and returns the caller's item **plus**:
sent (true/false) - send_status - wa_message_id - send_error - send_error_code - send_http_status - inbox_logged - inbox_error

**It only sends when the caller's send guard said yes** (decision.send === true, recipient = decision.to).
send_status: accepted (sent = true) | rejected (false, safe to retry) | uncertain (timeout: counts as sent, so no double message)
| not_requested / blocked / invalid (false, Meta was never called).

**Config node (W12 safety switches):**
- w12_send_mode: off | allowlist | live. Start with **allowlist**: only numbers in w12_allowlist can receive anything.
- w12_allowlist: comma-separated numbers (yours / your team's). w12_graph_api_version: copy from Meta API Setup (e.g. v23.0).
- w12_uncertain_counts_as_sent (true), w12_log_to_inbox (true: patient messages are written to Conversations + Messages; Send stays false).

**Set up once:** pick the *WhatsApp Cloud API* credential in "Meta send" and the *Grist* credential in the 3 Grist nodes.
Set Settings > Error workflow > W11. No need to activate (sub-workflows run when called).
**Test:** edit "Test input" (phone number id, your number), then Execute workflow. Start with hello_world.
Quiet hours (21:00-08:00 IST) block every send, tests included.

## SECTION FUTURE — RESERVED FOR NEW MODULES
W13, W14, W15, AI receptionist, AI lead qualification, payments, review automation, analytics, staff notifications, new clinic modules.

Rules for a new module:
1. Its own trigger (webhook path or schedule) and its own section sticky; never chain sections together.
2. Name nodes "W<n> – <name>"; Code-node references must use those names.
3. Start with a Config node and read the Agency Registry (never hard-code a clinic).
4. WhatsApp only through the W12 engine (see SECTION 00). Guards, TEST_MODE and sent flags as in CLAUDE.md.
5. Errors reach W11 automatically (same workflow).

## SECTION 00 — MASTER / ENTRY POINTS
**Clinic Autopilot runs as ONE workflow.** Every trigger below starts only its own section. Sections are not chained (no W1 -> W3 -> ...).

- **W1 – Webhook** — POST /webhook/website-lead -> SECTION W1
- **W3 – Every 10 minutes** — every 10 minutes -> SECTION W3
- **W4 – Webhook** — POST /webhook/cal-w4-test — NOT CONNECTED (does nothing) -> SECTION W4
- **W4 – Webhook1** — POST /webhook/cal -> SECTION W4
- **W5 – Every 15 minutes** — every 15 minutes -> SECTION W5
- **W6 – Daily 10:00** — cron 0 10 * * * -> SECTION W6
- **W11 – Error Trigger** — a production run of this workflow failed -> SECTION W11
- **W12 – When called by another workflow** — Execute Workflow node calling this workflow (W3 / W5 / W6 senders) -> SECTION W12
- **W12 – Manual test** — "Execute workflow" button in the editor (W12 test) -> SECTION W12

**WhatsApp:** only SECTION W12 calls Meta. To send WhatsApp from a new section: copy one of the "Call 'W12 - WhatsApp send'" nodes (it calls this workflow, mode: each) and give it items that carry `decision {send,to,reason,test_mode}`, `template`, `template_params`, `wa_phone_number_id`, `audience`, `source_workflow`, `message_text` (+ `grist_base_url`, `doc_id`, `lead_phone`, `lead_row_id` for patient messages). The item comes back with `sent`, `send_status`, `wa_message_id`, `send_error`.
**Errors:** SECTION W11 (Error Trigger). Settings > Error workflow stays EMPTY: this workflow is its own error workflow.

**Before activating:** deactivate the old W1, W3, W4, W5, W6 and W12 workflows (same webhook paths, double sends). Save this workflow before any test (sends call the SAVED version).
**Fill after import (kept out of the repo):** W4 – Config > cal_webhook_secret; W12 – Config > w12_allowlist; W12 – Test input > decision.to; W3 – Config > test_phone (unused).

parameters.content:
## W2 – WhatsApp Inbound (STANDALONE)
Meta WhatsApp Cloud API -> n8n -> the clinic's Grist CRM. **Not connected to any other workflow.** Sends nothing to WhatsApp.

**Webhook:** GET + POST `/webhook/whatsapp-inbound` (test URL: `/webhook-test/whatsapp-inbound`). Meta needs the PRODUCTION URL, so the workflow must be **Active**.

**Fill after import:** `W2 – Verify Config` > meta_verify_token (any string you choose; paste the SAME string in Meta). Nothing else is secret: Grist uses the existing credential "Header Auth account 2".

**Check in `W2 – Config`:** leads_table (LEADS), message_direction_in (In), message_status_in (Received), unread_mode (count). These follow grist/schema.md; see the README.

**Test first:** click Execute workflow on `W2 – Manual Test` (fake data only), then see README.md.

**Safe by design:** answers Meta 200 first, then processes one message at a time; duplicates (same WA_Message_ID) change nothing; no deletes; failures go to Run_Log.

## SECTION A — META WEBHOOK VERIFY (GET)
Meta calls this once when you save the webhook. It sends hub.mode, hub.verify_token and hub.challenge. The token must match "W2 – Verify Config"; then the challenge is echoed back as plain text. A wrong or unconfigured token answers 403.

## SECTION B — INBOUND POST + MANUAL TEST
Meta POST (or the manual test data) -> Config -> Parse. Webhook calls are answered right away (200 for anything Meta-shaped, 400 for garbage), then processing continues. Delivery receipts and other events are ignored. Messages are processed ONE AT A TIME.

## SECTION C — CLINIC, PHONE, DUPLICATE CHECK
phone_number_id -> Agency Registry Clinics (Active must be TRUE) -> unknown / inactive clinic stops here. Sender -> +91XXXXXXXXXX. Same WA_Message_ID already in Messages = duplicate: nothing is created.

## SECTION D — LEAD
Find the lead by normalized phone; if none, create one (Source WhatsApp, Status New, Lead_id L-YYYYMMDD-NNNN). After creating, look again: parallel messages from one new patient converge on the lowest row id.

## SECTION E — CONVERSATION
Find the conversation by normalized phone; if none, create it (Phone + Lead). After creating, look again: parallel messages converge on the lowest row id.

## SECTION F — MESSAGE, STAFF ALERT PAYLOAD, RUN_LOG
Add the Messages row (Direction In, WA_Message_ID), then update Last_Inbound_At / Unread (Automation_Paused and Assigned_To are never touched). A new lead prepares a staff-alert payload for W12 (decision.send = false: NOT sent from here). Every message ends in one Run_Log row: ok, skipped (duplicate, bad number) or failed (with the reason). A failing Run_Log write ends quietly: no retries, no loops.

## SECTION W13 — AI RECEPTIONIST (OpenRouter)
**Entry:** "W12 – AI Job?" (items with `w13_job` from W2, or `w13_retry` from the 08:05 run) and **W13 – Every Morning** (08:05: messages deferred overnight). One message per execution.

**Does:** reads clinic, Settings, Knowledge, the message, conversation, lead, history, Booked appointments → safety gates (handled, STOP, ai_mode, opted out, paused, Needs_Human, answered, newer message, emergency words → URGENT hand-off, night, media, rate limit) → marks the message `processing` → OpenRouter (Provider Request → Ask Model → Provider Answer) → **W13 – Plan** checks the JSON decision (schema, triage, confidence tiers 0.65 / 0.80 / 0.85, complaint/payment/medical → person, fact check of prices / times / links) → appointment writes → **W12** (this workflow, the only WhatsApp sender) → CRM writes + Run_Log.

**Fill after import:** credential **OpenRouter API** on `W13 – Ask Model`. **Switch on per clinic:** Settings `ai_mode` = draft / auto (missing = off). Dry runs: use the standalone "W13 DEMO" workflow (Manual Test).
